scene: a young woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a black one-piece swimsuit, stands at the curved edge of a round turquoise infinity pool; behind her rises a white sculptural concrete villa with a large smooth oval opening that frames the sea; beyond, the Mediterranean, red rocky cliffs and umbrella pines along the coast

options.label: Très gros plan
options.prompt: Extreme close-up: the camera is a few centimetres from her face; only her eyes, nose and lips fill the whole frame, cut off at the forehead and at the chin; no hair outline, no shoulders and no background visible
options.court: Un détail du visage remplit le cadre

options.label: Gros plan
options.prompt: Close-up: her face fills the frame from the top of the forehead to just below the chin and takes up about 80 percent of the frame height; her shoulders and the setting are out of frame, only a hint of blurred background at the edges

options.label: Plan rapproché poitrine
options.prompt: Medium close-up, head and shoulders: framed from just above her head down to the middle of her chest; her waist, hips and legs are out of frame; her head takes up about a third of the frame height
options.court: Tête et épaules, jusqu'à la poitrine

options.label: Plan taille
options.prompt: Medium shot: framed from just above her head down to her waist; her hips and legs are out of frame; she fills most of the frame height

options.label: Plan américain
options.prompt: Medium long shot, cowboy shot: framed from just above her head down to mid-thigh; her knees, lower legs and feet are out of frame

options.label: Plan pied
options.prompt: Full shot: the main subject's whole body is visible from head to feet and fills most of the frame height, with a little space above the head and below the feet
options.court: Le corps entier, de la tête aux pieds

options.label: Plan large
options.prompt: Wide shot: the whole figure is small, about a third of the frame height, clearly placed in her surroundings, and the setting dominates the image
options.court: La silhouette, petite, dans son décor

options.label: Plan d'ensemble
options.prompt: Extreme wide establishing shot: a vast view of the whole location, in which the main subject is a tiny figure less than a tenth of the frame height
options.court: Le lieu entier, le sujet minuscule

options.label: Insert
options.prompt: Insert shot: a tight view of a single small detail of the scene, such as a hand resting on the stone edge of the pool, isolated from everything else
options.court: Un objet ou une main, isolés

options.label: À hauteur d'yeux
options.prompt: Eye-level shot: the camera stands about 1.6 metres above the ground, exactly at her eye height, perfectly level, facing her straight on; the sea horizon crosses the frame at the height of her eyes, the pool edge is seen almost edge-on, no downward or upward tilt, all vertical lines perfectly vertical

options.label: Plongée
options.prompt: High-angle shot: the camera is well above the main subject, looking down at her at about 45 degrees, so the ground is visible all around her
options.court: La caméra domine et regarde en bas

options.label: Contre-plongée
options.prompt: Low-angle shot: the camera is near the ground looking up at the main subject, who towers against the sky
options.court: La caméra au sol regarde en haut

options.label: Plongée zénithale
options.prompt: Top-down overhead shot: the camera looks straight down from directly above, so the scene is seen as a flat map from the sky
options.court: Vue d'en haut, à la verticale

options.label: Ras du sol
options.prompt: Worm's-eye view from ground level: the lens rests on the ground just in front of her feet, the stone floor fills the bottom of the frame in the immediate foreground, she towers above the camera, seen from below, and the sky fills the top of the frame

options.label: Plan débullé
options.prompt: Dutch angle: the camera is tilted sideways by 25 degrees, so the whole picture is rotated; the sea horizon is clearly slanted, running diagonally from high on one side of the frame to low on the other, and the walls of the villa and the woman lean at the same strong diagonal

options.label: Par-dessus l'épaule
options.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot: the out-of-focus back of another person's head and shoulder fills one side of the near foreground, looking toward the main subject
options.court: Une épaule floue au premier plan

options.label: Subjectif
options.prompt: First-person point of view, as if seen through the viewer's own eyes at standing height: the viewer's two hands and forearms enter naturally from the bottom edge of the frame, reaching toward her

options.label: Vue aérienne
options.prompt: Aerial view from about thirty metres up, looking down at an angle over the whole location

options.label: Fisheye 8 mm
options.prompt: Fisheye lens: a circular, strongly curved image in which straight lines bow outward, with an extremely wide 180-degree view

options.label: 14 mm
options.prompt: Ultra-wide 14mm lens very close to the subject: exaggerated perspective, nearby objects look huge and distant ones tiny, straight lines lean at the edges of the frame

options.label: 24 mm
options.prompt: Wide-angle 24mm lens close to the subject: a broad view of the surroundings with strong depth and visible perspective

options.label: 35 mm
options.prompt: 35mm lens: natural documentary perspective, subject and surroundings in balance

options.label: 50 mm
options.prompt: 50mm lens: natural human-eye perspective with neutral proportions

options.label: 85 mm
options.prompt: 85mm portrait lens from a few metres away: flattering, slightly compressed perspective, the background looks closer and larger behind the subject

options.label: 135 mm
options.prompt: 135mm telephoto lens from far away: strongly compressed perspective, distant background elements appear stacked right behind the subject, narrow field of view

options.label: f/1.4
options.prompt: Very shallow depth of field: only the main subject is sharp, the background dissolves into a smooth creamy blur with large round bokeh

options.label: f/2.8
options.prompt: Shallow depth of field: the main subject is sharp and the background is softly out of focus but still recognisable

options.label: f/5.6
options.prompt: Moderate depth of field: the main subject and her immediate surroundings are sharp, the far background only slightly soft
options.court: Le sujet et ses abords nets

options.label: f/11
options.prompt: Deep focus: everything from the nearest foreground to the far horizon is sharp
options.court: Tout est net, du premier plan au loin

options.label: Heure dorée
options.prompt: Golden hour: a low warm sun near the horizon, long soft shadows and orange light raking across the scene

options.label: Heure bleue
options.prompt: Blue hour just after sunset: deep blue twilight, no direct sunlight, warm lights glowing in the villa

options.label: Ciel couvert
options.prompt: Overcast sky: soft, even, shadowless daylight and muted contrast

options.label: Midi dur
options.prompt: Harsh midday sun straight overhead: hard, short, dark shadows and bright, almost blown highlights

options.label: Contre-jour
options.prompt: Backlit by the sun behind the subject: a glowing rim of light outlines her hair and shoulders, her face in soft shadow, a light haze in the air

options.label: Clair-obscur
options.prompt: Low-key side light: a single hard light from one side lights half of her face and body, the other half falls into deep shadow

options.label: Nuit éclairée
options.prompt: Night scene lit only by practical lights: glowing windows, small lamps and underwater pool lights, colored reflections, deep shadows

options.label: Silhouette
options.prompt: Silhouette: a bright sky behind her turns the subject into a dark outline with almost no detail

options.label: Naturel
options.prompt: Natural, true-to-life color with a neutral white balance

options.label: Chaud pastel
options.prompt: Warm pastel color palette: creamy highlights, warm skin tones, soft low contrast, gentle saturation

options.label: Tungstène
options.prompt: Cool blue-cyan shadows against warm amber highlights, rich deep blacks

options.label: Désaturé doux
options.prompt: Muted low-saturation palette: soft greens and teals, low contrast, matte shadows

options.label: Teal & orange
options.prompt: Teal shadows and warm orange skin tones, a cinematic blockbuster color grade

options.label: Sans blanchiment
options.prompt: Bleach-bypass look, almost monochrome: the water, the sky and the rocks are nearly gray with only faint traces of color, high contrast, silvery highlights and dense blacks

options.label: Noir & blanc
options.prompt: Strictly monochrome black-and-white photograph, every part of the image is a shade of gray, including the water, the sky, the rocks and the skin; no color at all and no tint: rich gray tones, deep blacks and bright whites

options.label: Zeiss Master Prime
options.prompt: Rendered through modern ultra-sharp cinema optics: crisp detail from edge to edge, high micro-contrast, neutral slightly cool color, no flare and no distortion, a smooth round background blur
options.court: Très net bord à bord, neutre

options.label: Cooke S4
options.prompt: Rendered through classic British cinema primes: warm, flattering skin, gentle contrast, focus that falls off smoothly and gradually behind her, soft round background blur
options.court: Chaud, doux, chute de net douce

options.label: ARRI Signature Prime
options.prompt: Rendered through large-format modern cinema primes: very clean yet gentle rendering of skin, the smoothest creamy background blur, a hint of warmth, no harshness

options.label: Canon K-35
options.prompt: Rendered through 1970s vintage cinema primes shot wide open: low contrast, warm pastel skin tones, a soft warm veiling glow over the image, large golden and amber flares and ghost reflections from the sun, gently soft edges

options.label: Helios 44-2
options.prompt: Rendered through a vintage Soviet 58mm portrait optic wide open: the out-of-focus background swirls in a circular pattern around the sharp subject, soft corners, slightly low contrast, a mild vignette

options.label: Petzval
options.prompt: Rendered through a 19th-century brass portrait optic: a very sharp centre, a strong swirling blur and heavy darkening towards the edges and corners, warm vintage rendering

options.label: Lensbaby
options.prompt: Rendered through a selective-focus optic: a single small sweet spot of sharpness on her, everything else blurring progressively towards the edges with a soft dreamy glow

options.label: Panavision anamorphique
options.prompt: Widescreen cinema look with the sun low behind the villa: long horizontal blue streaks of light run straight across the bright highlights, out-of-focus lights in the background are stretched vertically into tall soft capsules, organic medium contrast. Rectangular full-bleed image: the scene fills the frame right into the corners, bright corners
options.court: Traînées bleues, flou étiré en hauteur

options.label: Anamorphique moderne
options.prompt: Widescreen cinema look: the background melts into a strong blur whose out-of-focus lights are stretched vertically into tall soft capsules, the woman is crisp, high contrast, a thin straight horizontal blue streak of light. Rectangular full-bleed image: the scene fills the frame right into the corners, bright corners
options.court: Flou étiré en hauteur, sujet net

options.label: Filtre Black Pro-Mist
options.prompt: Shot through a black diffusion filter: bright highlights bloom into a soft glow, the sun and its reflections on the water are surrounded by a gentle halo, contrast is softened in the highlights while the blacks stay deep, skin looks smooth

options.label: Macro 100 mm
options.prompt: Macro close-up at 1:1 magnification: an extreme close detail of water droplets on her shoulder beside the strap of the black swimsuit, fine skin texture, a razor-thin plane of focus, everything else dissolving into smooth blur

options.label: Tilt-shift
options.prompt: Single tilt-shift photograph taken from a high balcony looking down at the pool: one narrow horizontal zone of sharp focus runs through the woman, and the image gets smoothly and progressively blurrier toward the top and the bottom edges, vivid colors, so the whole real scene looks like a tiny scale model; one continuous photo, not a collage

options.label: ARRI Alexa 35
options.support: cinematic digital motion-picture frame in Super 35 format
options.optique: 35mm-equivalent field of view; the subject is sharp and the background falls gently out of focus but stays readable
options.couleur: natural, gently warm color with true-to-life soft skin tones and restrained saturation; highlights roll off smoothly into white without clipping and the deep shadows keep their detail
options.texture: clean image with a barely visible fine organic noise and soft, unsharpened detail

options.label: ARRI Alexa Mini LF
options.optique: wide, immersive large-format perspective with a very shallow depth of field: the subject is sharp while the background melts into a soft creamy blur
options.couleur: natural, gently warm color with true-to-life soft skin tones and restrained saturation; very smooth highlight roll-off
options.texture: smooth tonality, fine clean detail, no sharpening

options.label: Sony Venice 2
options.optique: full-frame shallow depth of field: sharp subject, smoothly blurred background
options.couleur: rich, deep, saturated yet natural color, glowing healthy skin tones, clean neutral whites and dense clean black shadows
options.texture: very clean, noise-free image with smooth gradients

options.label: RED V-Raptor
options.optique: shallow depth of field, sharp subject against a blurred background
options.couleur: punchy contrast, vivid saturated color and crisp neutral whites
options.texture: hyper-detailed, razor-sharp micro-detail on skin, hair and stone, crisp edges, no grain

options.label: Pellicule 35 mm
options.support: photographed on 35mm color negative motion-picture film and printed on film
options.optique: moderate depth of field, the background softly out of focus
options.couleur: warm film-print colors: creamy highlights, slightly teal-green shadows, rich but natural saturation, gentle contrast with a soft shoulder in the highlights
options.texture: fine organic film grain visible in the midtones and the sky, a faint red halation glow around the brightest highlights

options.label: Pellicule 16 mm
options.optique: deeper focus than 35mm, the background only slightly soft
options.couleur: muted, slightly faded colors, lifted milky blacks and a warm cast
options.texture: clearly visible coarse film grain across the whole image, slightly soft overall sharpness, reddish halation on highlights, full-frame image with no black border

options.label: Super 8
options.support: Super 8 reversal-film home-movie frame from the 1970s
options.optique: everything roughly in focus through a small soft lens
options.couleur: warm but natural colors with slightly faded reds, deep contrasty shadows, no strong yellow cast
options.texture: heavy coarse grain and soft blurry detail, full-frame image with no black border, no vignette and no film-gate edges

options.label: IMAX 65 mm
options.optique: immense depth and scale with an extremely shallow depth of field: razor-sharp subject, background dissolving into soft blur
options.couleur: rich, natural film colors with deep blacks and creamy highlights
options.texture: astonishing fine detail and an extremely fine, almost invisible grain

options.label: iPhone
options.support: casual eye-level snapshot with a wide 26mm-equivalent field of view
options.optique: deep focus: foreground and background both sharp
options.couleur: bright computational HDR: lifted shadows, flattened contrast, vivid saturated colors and smoothed skin
options.texture: crisp over-sharpened edges, clean digital image without grain

options.label: Caméra d'action
options.support: action-cam frame: ultra-wide 150-degree view held very close to the subject
options.optique: strong barrel distortion bending straight lines near the edges, a curved horizon, everything in sharp focus from near to far
options.couleur: punchy, highly saturated colors with a vivid blue sky and water and high contrast
options.texture: crisp digital sharpening and slight noise in the shadows

options.label: Drone
options.support: aerial drone frame, seen from about 20 metres up and 30 metres away, looking down at 30 degrees
options.optique: deep focus, the whole landscape sharp, wide view
options.couleur: vivid saturated landscape colors, a bright clean HDR look and a slightly hazy distance
options.texture: crisp digital detail with slight sharpening

options.label: Caméscope VHS
options.support: frame from a 1990s home-video camcorder tape
options.optique: everything in focus through a small wide lens
options.couleur: washed-out colors bleeding past their edges, pale blacks and a slight color cast
options.texture: low resolution, soft smeared detail and faint horizontal video noise lines

scene_serre: a young woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a black one-piece swimsuit; the white villa, the turquoise pool and the sea are only a soft, out-of-focus background behind her
